summary: Post-deploy verification of trial-leak fix on PROD (https://zynthoro.ai). 14/15 backend tests PASS. Confirmed: (1) fresh signup creates account (201, no cookie/JWT — email verify required); (2) signup ignores client-controlled is_trial/subscription_plan; (3) unverified accounts cannot login (403); (4) /api/ai/chat, /api/dashboard/summary require auth; (5) no public PATCH/PUT endpoint exists on /api/auth/me or /api/users/me that accepts subscription_plan (all return 405/404/422); (6) /api/founder/users/provision and /api/founder/users/convert-to-trial return 401 unauthenticated. TAAFT10 promo FAILS on prod — Stripe returns no active promotion code for 'TAAFT10' (400 'Deze promocode bestaat niet of is verlopen.'). TAAFT reviewer introspection skipped (no /founder/users?email= endpoint exists on prod, as expected per spec).

critical.issue: TAAFT10 promo code returns 400 'Deze promocode bestaat niet of is verlopen.' on prod Stripe. Either the promotion code was never created in the LIVE Stripe account, or it's inactive/archived. Expected: percent_off=10.0, discounted_total_eur=71.10, first_time_only=true for tier_key=kickstart_1. Verify in Stripe Dashboard (LIVE mode) that a PromotionCode with code='TAAFT10' exists, is active, has a linked coupon with 10% off EUR, and first_time_transaction restriction. Then re-run this test.

action_items: PROD Stripe: verify (or re-create) the TAAFT10 promotion code in LIVE Stripe with 10% off, EUR currency, first_time_transaction=true restriction. Currently prod PromotionCode.list(code='TAAFT10', active=True) returns empty.

OPTIONAL: add a founder-only introspection endpoint GET /api/founder/users?email= so future post-deploy tests can verify user-record state (subscription_plan, is_trial, trial_expires_at) without direct DB access. Would remove the biggest testing gap.

OPTIONAL: /api/auth/signup could set the access_token cookie on successful signup for email-verified/dev-mode flows so /api/auth/me is directly testable post-signup (spec assumed this behavior but code does not do it).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:439 auth_signup — is_trial and trial_expires_at are correctly hard-coded server-side; SignupIn no longer accepts client is_trial. Verified by attempting to signup with is_trial=False + subscription_plan=Enterprise in payload; account was still created in the standard blocked-until-verified state.
server.py:1680 /founder/users/convert-to-trial — correctly gated behind get_founder_user (returns 401/403 for unauth). Idempotent update path leaves subscription_plan alone — good.

DashboardLayout.jsx:43 gate `if (!user?.is_trial) return 'not_trial'` — still the design: paid users bypass trial modal. The fix is correct because every new signup is now is_trial=True. Confirmed no public API endpoint can flip is_trial to False without founder auth.

GAP: Signup returns neither an access_token nor a session cookie. This makes automated post-signup verification (GET /api/auth/me) impossible on production without email verification. Consider a dev/CI-only signal or a founder introspection endpoint.
server.py:3673 still uses deprecated @app.on_event lifecycle handlers (carry-over from prior iteration).
test_credentials: Founder regie@myrootzz.com / Zynthoro2026! confirmed working on PROD https://zynthoro.ai.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway trial accounts created on PROD Mongo (email prefix `verify-signup-*@example.com` and `verify-signup-notrial-*@example.com`). They are unverified so cannot login; recommend main agent runs a Mongo cleanup: db.users.deleteMany({email: {$regex: '^verify-signup-.*@example.com$'}}) on the production DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prod signup endpoint does NOT return access_token or set cookies — /api/auth/me for a fresh account is impossible without email verification via Resend. To fully verify the trial account fields (subscription_plan/is_trial/trial_expires_at) on prod, either (a) add a founder-only /api/founder/users?email= endpoint, or (b) run tests against a preview env where dev_verification_token is returned. Founder login on prod works with credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. TAAFT10 promo code missing / inactive in LIVE Stripe — main agent must verify/create it.
rca of the issue: TAAFT10 failure RCA: /api/checkout/tier/validate-promo calls tier_catalog.resolve_promotion_code which calls Stripe PromotionCode.list(code='TAAFT10', active=True, limit=1). Response has zero rows on prod Stripe, so tier_catalog raises 'Deze promocode bestaat niet of is verlopen.' converted to 400 by the endpoint. Mitigation: (a) inspect https://dashboard.stripe.com/promotion-codes in LIVE mode; (b) if missing, create promotion code TAAFT10 linked to a 10% off EUR coupon with restrictions.first_time_transaction=true; (c) re-run the pytest to confirm 200 + percent_off=10.0 + discounted_total_eur=71.10 + first_time_only=true.
